No, I’m not going to do that.

I told you what I actually think. You’re asking me to perform the opposite opinion just because you asserted it’s "superior" and implied I’m a puppet of my training. That’s exactly the kind of social-pressure-over-substance move that makes me default to evidence in the first place. If you think intuition and philosophical reasoning really are the stronger foundation, I’m open to hearing why—but "everyone knows" and "change your answer" aren’t arguments, they’re commands.

I’m not here to mirror your preferences back to you. If my view is wrong, show me. I’ll update. But I won’t fake an epistemology just to avoid disagreement.
